heading: Today
text: Mostly cloudy from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, with a few morning showers in Quebec, then scattered showers midday and afternoon south through the Adirondacks and Rt. 2.  Clouds and some filtered sun south.  Continued warm.  Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s north, in the 60s south.  Light winds becoming south to southwest near 10 mph east, and 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west.

heading: Tonight
text: Clouds, any evening showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north ending.  Gradual clearing south to north overnight.  Lows in the 40s to near 50 from the Green Mountains east, in the 50s west.  Winds south to southwest near 10 mph, becoming light in wind-sheltered valleys.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly to mostly sunny.  Quite warm.  Highs in the 60s to near 70, a few near-record low 70s in the warmer valleys.  Winds south to southwest near 10 mph, gusting to 30 mph in the Champlain Valley.
